items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But my other brother was Elpanzo; he played

ctx.x: My uncle…Uncle Guy. Guy Williams. My uncle Guy and my uncle, he was a half brother; Guy Williams was a half brother. But my other brother was Elpanzo; he played, oh man I can‘t think of this now. He played guitar and banjo and harp. They had a nice group, they even traveled around. This string group, that‘s really when I was like five or six years old, so I don‘t recall too much about that.
Did you play a string instrument also, the zither?
